name: teste-gastos
description: Controle de gastos: importa extratos em PDF, extrai (texto/OCR), categoriza e armazena em SQLite.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:extractor && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup:extractor: python3 -m venv extractor/.venv && extractor/.venv/bin/pip install -q -r extractor/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
